html.title: WarSampo 2.0
html.description: The Sampo-UI framework makes it possible to create highly customizable, user-friendly, and responsive user interfaces using current state-of-the-art JavaScript libraries and data from SPARQL endpoints.

appTitle.subheading: Note: The user interface is still under development, so not all features have been implemented yet, and you may encounter bugs during use.

appDescription1: Sampo is a web service for searching and studying place names. The search results can be viewed as a table, on maps, and as statistical distributions. Historical and current background maps are provided.
appDescription2: Start by choosing source dataset(s) and input a place name on the search field. Alternatively you can search by area.

instancePageGeneral.introduction:
This landing page provides a human-readable summary of the data points that link to this {entity}. The data included in this summary reflect only those data points used in the MMM Portal. Click the Open in Linked Data Browser on button on the Export tab to view the complete set of classes and properties linked to this record.

To cite this record, use its url. You can use also use the url to return directly to the record at any time.
instancePageGeneral.repetition:
Repetition of data

The same or similar data may appear within a single data field multiple times. This repetition occurs due to the merging of multiple records from different datasets to create the MMM record.

aboutThePortalPartOne:
The WarSampo 2.0 project is part of the broader WarSampo initiative and portal, which has already had over 1,300,000 visitors by the end of 2025. Internationally recognized (LODLAM Open Data Prize, Venice, 2017), WarSampo is part of the Sampo systems series and utilizes the national linked open data infrastructure FIN-CLARIN/DARIAH-FI.

Our goal is to develop a new Sampo-UI-based version of WarSampo that enables data analysis and visualization of the materials. The user interface is still under development, so not all features have been implemented yet, and the information texts within the interface are still incomplete. You may also encounter bugs or other errors while using the system; you can submit feedback about these via the feedback link on the WarSampo 2.0 portal.

If you encounter data-related errors that are not related to military cards or Sotapolku links, please report them via the feedback form on the original WarSampo portal (WarSampo portal > Feedback > The feedback concerns correction of the contained information).

exportLink.viewInstructions: Choose the tab in which the query will open
exportLink.infoBody: You can share the query you made by using the link below. The link is generated based on what you have selected for different facets and will open the search view of this perspective with those choices on the selected tab. You can change the opened tab to any of the supported ones using the dropdown menu below. If you make additional choices while on this page, the link will be automatically updated to include those.
exportLink.warningTitle: Generated link might be too long for some browsers
exportLink.warningBody: The current length of the generated link is more than 2,000 characters. Browsers have different limits for the maximum lengths of links they can handle. This link might not work on all browsers — you can reduce the length of the link by deselecting some facet options.
exportLink.errorBody: The current length of the generated link is more than 15,800 characters. The server will refuse to handle requests that go over certain length limits — you can reduce the length of the link by deselecting some facet options.
